title: Malaysian Pork Bao
description: A delicious and tender pork bao dish inspired by Malaysian flavors.
instructions: 2. In a blender or food processor, blend ginger, garlic, soy sauce, and hoisin sauce to make the marinade.
3. Place the pork tenderloin in a large ziplock bag and pour the marinade over it. Seal and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
4. Remove the pork from the marinade and cook in a skillet with peanut oil over medium-high heat until browned on all sides.
5. Transfer the pork to the oven and roast for 20-25 minutes or until cooked to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
6. While the pork is cooking, steam the bao buns for 5-7 minutes or until they are soft and pliable.
7. Slice the cooked pork into thick pieces.
8. To assemble the baos, place a few slices of pork onto a steamed bao bun, followed by a sprinkle of scallions and a few bean sprouts.
9. Drizzle sesame oil over the top and serve immediately.
